segments.text: And all his ſervants are called thither, to preſent their bodies and ſoules, and to bring their gifts God hath given them; ſo being come, they are here by himſelfe beſtowed in their ſeverall order, peculiar place, due uſe, being fitly compact and knit together, according to the effectuall working of every part, to the edification of it ſelfe in love.
